text: しかし　＊が　さわいでいて　ねむれなかった！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows something going on at that moment. さわいでいて = 'was making an uproar, and'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: Ending the first part in て joins it to the next, and here it gives the reason for what follows. さわいでいて　ねむれなかった = 'was making noise, so it couldn't sleep'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing ねむる to ねむれる means 'can sleep'. Here it is negative and past. ねむれなかった = 'couldn't sleep'.
